sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to practice slow English conversations with you. I'm excited to have another slow English podcast with my sister. This English podcast is about weekend routines.
sentences.tc: 今天我想和你們練習慢速英語會話。我很高興能和姐姐一起做另一個慢速英語播客。這個英語播客是關於週末例行公事的。

sentences.en: You can practice listening to English chats, hearing the questions and giving an answer. Okay.
sentences.tc: 您可以練習聽英語聊天、聽問題並給出答案。好的。

sentences.en: We do on the weekend. What time.
sentences.tc: 我們週末做。什麼時候。

tags.meaning: 日常生活相關的常用字
tags.note: 看到 weekend 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: Do you wake up on the weekend? On the weekend?
sentences.tc: 週末你起床嗎？週末？

sentences.en: I usually sleep in late. I don't like to wake up too early.
sentences.tc: 我通常睡得很晚。我不喜歡起得太早。

sentences.en: I wake up around 9 or 10:00. Not too early. I don't like waking up early on the weekends,.
sentences.tc: 我在 9 或 10:00 左右醒來。還不算太早。週末我不喜歡早起。

sentences.en: I also don't like waking up too late. So, I think 9 to 10 is the perfect time to wake up on the weekends.
sentences.tc: 我也不喜歡起得太晚。所以，我認為9點到10點是週末起床的最佳時機。

sentences.en: What about you?
sentences.tc: 你呢？

sentences.en: I wake up usually around 7 7:30 a.m. because during the week I always wake up at 7 or 7:30 a.m. So my body wakes up and I can't fall asleep anymore.
sentences.tc: 我通常在早上 7 點 7:30 左右醒來，因為平日我總是在早上 7 點或 7:30 起床。所以我的身體醒來了，我就再也睡不著了。

sentences.en: What do you usually eat for breakfast?
sentences.tc: 你早餐通常吃什麼？

sentences.en: I normally eat oatmeal with lots of fruit, yogurt, and honey. But lately, I've been really enjoying avocado toast with eggs. I used to not like eggs at all, but now.
sentences.tc: 我通常吃燕麥片加很多水果、優格和蜂蜜。但最近，我真的很喜歡酪梨雞蛋吐司。我以前根本不喜歡雞蛋，但現在。

sentences.en: They're starting to grow on me, but my absolute favorite breakfast is a banana smoothie with kefir, chia, flax seed, and bananas. And what about you?
sentences.tc: 它們開始讓我著迷，但我最喜歡的早餐是香蕉冰沙，裡面有克菲爾、奇亞籽、亞麻籽和香蕉。那你呢？

sentences.en: I usually have just eggs for breakfast. Only eggs.
sentences.tc: 我早餐通常只吃蛋。只有雞蛋。

sentences.en: Sometimes too busy to make anything else. You don't like eggs with toast or avocado or maybe ketchup?
sentences.tc: 有時太忙，無暇做其他事。您不喜歡雞蛋配吐司、酪梨或番茄醬嗎？

sentences.en: Sometimes eggs in a tortilla with salsa is what I'll have for breakfast. Okay.
sentences.tc: 有時我早餐會吃玉米餅裡的雞蛋和莎莎醬。好的。

sentences.en: Do you drink coffee or tea?
sentences.tc: 你喝咖啡還是茶？

sentences.en: In the morning? Neither. I drink neither coffee nor tea.
sentences.tc: 在早晨？兩者都不。我既不喝咖啡也不喝茶。

sentences.en: In the morning. I drink smoothies.
sentences.tc: 在早晨。我喝冰沙。

sentences.en: In the morning every day. What about you? I drink smoothies if I have time.
sentences.tc: 每天早上。你呢？如果有時間的話我會喝冰沙。

sentences.en: Do you like to have slow mornings or busy, productive mornings over the weekend? I prefer to have slow mornings,?
sentences.tc: 週末你喜歡度過悠閒的早晨還是忙碌而富有成效的早晨？我比較喜歡緩慢的早晨，？

sentences.en: I like to keep my afternoons busy.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡讓下午保持忙碌。

sentences.en: I usually try to either stretch or exercise or do yoga as a slow morning routine.
sentences.tc: 我通常會嘗試將伸展運動、運動或瑜伽作為緩慢的早晨例行公事。

sentences.en: Then I'll try to do something more productive. And in the evenings, I'll try to just read a book or watch TV and relax from a busy week. How about you?
sentences.tc: 然後我會嘗試做一些更有成效的事情。晚上，我會嘗試看書或看電視，從忙碌的一周放鬆下來。你呢？
